source.title: Clef: Open-weight decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform
source.author: jasondavies

excerpt.zh: Cloudflare 推出开源决策模型 Clef 和 Clef-flash，性能超越 Jev 系统一，附带新 RL 微调平台。
excerpt.en: Cloudflare has released its open-weight decision models Clef and Clef-flash, outperforming the Jev Decision Index with its new RL fine-tuning platform.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Cloudflare 推出开源决策模型 Clef 和 Clef-flash，由 Cloudflare 自主训练并部署在 Workers AI 上。Clef 在 Jev Decision Index 基准测试中领先，是首个性能超越 Jev 系统一的决策模型。
text.en: Cloudflare is releasing its open-weight decision models Clef and Clef-flash, trained in-house and hosted on Workers AI. Clef leads the Jev Decision Index benchmark, making it the first model to surpass the Jev System One.

text.zh: 决策模型通过概率输出分类，帮助代理决定如何行动。它能为任何输入集生成结构化、有界的输出，无需每次新分类类别时重新训练。这与 LLM 的非确定性生成形成对比。
text.en: A decision model produces classifications that help agents decide how to act, based on probabilities. It generates bounded, structured outputs for any input set without retraining for new categories — unlike the non-deterministic, open-ended outputs of LLMs.

text.zh: Clef 已完全开源，遵循 Apache 2.0 许可，可在 Hugging Face 上本地运行。Clef-flash 更轻量，适合低延迟场景。两者均支持 Jev-API 兼容，便于开发者无缝集成。
text.en: Both models are fully open-sourced under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face for local experimentation. Clef-flash is optimized for low-latency use cases. They are fully Jev-API compatible for easy integration into workflows.

text.zh: Cloudflare 还推出新 RL 微调平台，可针对特定用例微调 Clef。这降低了部署门槛，让代理不再依赖人类循环，实现更自主的决策。
text.en: Cloudflare is also launching a new RL fine-tuning platform that allows customers to adapt Clef to their specific use cases. This lowers barriers to deployment and reduces reliance on human-in-the-loop for agentic decisions.

text.zh: 开源与 RL 微调的推出，标志着决策模型进入大众可及阶段，为企业构建更智能、可靠的 AI 代理提供有力支持。
text.en: The open-source release and RL fine-tuning platform mark the mainstreaming of decision models, empowering enterprises to build smarter, more reliable AI agents.
